Características del producto

𝐎𝐧𝐞 𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐔𝐩𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐞: soundcore is now Anker soundcore. We've always been part of Anker — now our name says it. Same products, same quality, same team. Your app, your account, and your warranty work exactly as before. Only the name has changed.

𝐂𝐫𝐲𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐥-𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐬: Powered by the ANKER Thus AI chip, 4 mics and 2 VPUs isolate your voice instead of filtering noises, so you can speak naturally in 80+ db noisy environments or whisper in quiet rooms, and still be heard clearly. Certified by Guinness World Records.

𝐆𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐅𝐢𝐭 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐒𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭: Built on 2,000+ ear scans, the GoldenFit C-bridge keeps a secure, comfortable hold, while the contoured acoustic and battery chambers follow your ear's curve. At just 6.2 g per earbud, it feels barely there, even all day long.

𝐃𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐁𝐚𝐬𝐬, 𝐁𝐫𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐬: Enjoy Hi-Res Audio with LDAC and a 12 mm dual-magnet driver featuring an aerospace-grade metal and advanced polymer diaphragm. Hear punchy lows and detailed highs for an immersive listening experience.

𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞, 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐝: Hear your music, podcasts, and calls while staying aware of the world around you, from approaching traffic to conversations and everything in between.

𝐌𝐅𝐢-𝐜𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐀𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲: MFi-certified to meet Apple's rigorous standards — pairs instantly, holds rock-solid without dropouts, and delivers smooth, stable use across every Apple device.

𝐀𝐈 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝟏𝟎𝟎+ 𝐋𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐮𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐬: Break language barriers with real-time, two-way translation through the soundcore app. Communicate effortlessly at work or while traveling.

𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐀𝐧𝐤𝐞𝐫, 𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐲 𝟖𝟎 𝐌𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐨𝐧+ 𝐔𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝𝐰𝐢𝐝𝐞: AeroClip 2 brings together crystal-clear calls, Hi-Res Audio, GoldenFit comfort, and AI translation in one premium open-ear design, giving you a clearer, more confident experience at work and in everyday life.

𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐀𝐩𝐩 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭: Download the soundcore app for software updates and access to available features. Personalize your listening with HearID, EQ modes and Spatial Audio . OTA firmware updates help keep your earbuds updated.
